text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "structure with clear intro, three distinct body paragraphs (activities, mental health, school staff), and conclusion", "quality": "structural organization", "description": "Captures the author's ability to arrange ideas into a coherent framework with a clear thesis, clear main points, and a restated conclusion."}, {"evidence": "use of transitional phrases such as \"Although school is important...\", \"For example,\", \"Due to all the demands...\", and \"To emphasize further,\"", "quality": "cohesive device usage", "description": "Captures the effective use of transitional words and phrases to connect ideas within and between paragraphs."}, {"evidence": "explanations of biological stress mechanisms (Cortisol) and specific group work scenarios at camp", "quality": "elaboration of supporting ideas", "description": "Captures how fully and deeply a writer develops supporting arguments using specific examples, details, and logical explanations."}, {"evidence": "words like \"detirriation\", \"neurotransmitter\", \"hypertension\", \"collaboratively\", and \"impair\"", "quality": "advanced vocabulary usage", "description": "Captures the writer's command of precise, varied, and academic vocabulary."}, {"evidence": "complex sentence constructions like \"Eventhough, they are not keeping their brains engaged in terms of school work... they are exposing themselves to new activities...\"", "quality": "syntactic complexity", "description": "Captures the writer's ability to construct varied, multi-clause, and sophisticated sentence structures accurately."}]}
